titulo.es: "Bolsonaro nunca más": miles marchan en Río contra Flávio Bolsonaro antes del balotaje
titulo.en: ‘Another coup d’état’: fears grow as Flávio Bolsonaro vows to ‘re-democratise’ Brazil

Bajo la consigna "Bolsonaro nunca más", los participantes expresaron su temor a los recortes presupuestarios y a la propuesta del senador de amnistiar a su padre, condenado por intentar un golpe de Estado.
sintesis.en: After a surprise first-round victory, critics suggest son of disgraced ex-president could seek to continue his father’s authoritarian project Flávio’s surprise first-round win highlights rapid rise of Brazil’s House of Bolsonaro Flávio Bolsonaro, the far-right frontrunner to become Brazil’s next president , has vowed to “re-democratise” the South American country, increasing fears about a move into authoritarian rule if he wins power. Brazil was re-democratised in the 1980s after a brutal 21-year dictatorship that Flávio’s father, the disgraced ex-president Jair Bolsonaro, has long praised. Continue reading...

titulo.es: British consulate in East Jerusalem will stay open as UK mission, says Ed Miliband
titulo.en: British consulate in East Jerusalem will stay open as UK mission, says Ed Miliband

sintesis.es: UK and Israel back away from full diplomatic confrontation, though British presence in Palestine will be much reduced UK politics live – latest updates Israel and the UK have backed away from a full-scale diplomatic confrontation, with Britain announcing it is rebranding its consulate general ⁠building in ⁠East Jerusalem ​as a UK mission, a move that will result in UK diplomats leaving Israel, with only seven to remain in the building. The change was forced on the UK by the Israeli government as punishment for the decision by the foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, last month to ban trade with illegal settlements and introduce a tougher sanctions regime against those who aided the building of settlements. The UK is seeking to protect the two-state solution as the best means of ending the Israeli-Palestine conflict.

titulo.es: Fourteen African countries, key partners unite to provide critical resources for health in WHO’s first-ever Investment Round
titulo.en: Fourteen African countries, key partners unite to provide critical resources for health in WHO’s first-ever Investment Round

sintesis.es: In an unprecedented show of unity in support of the World Health Organization, 14 African countries and many partners pledged over US$ 45 million to the WHO Investment Round, a three-month-old initiative aimed at generating sustainable financing for the organization at the center of the global health architecture. The commitments were made during the World Health Organization (WHO) Regional Committee for Africa, with heads of state and government from across the continent underscoring the importance of investing in global health and ensuring a strong WHO. “I thank our African Region Member States for actively supporting WHO’s first Investment Round to mobilize predictable and flexible resources needed for our core work over the next four years,” said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General.

titulo.es: Muere Maricarmen Abascal, símbolo de la crisis de vivienda en España, y estallan protestas en Madrid
titulo.en: Maricarmen Abascal, symbol of Spain's housing crisis, dies, sparking protests in Madrid

sintesis.es: Maricarmen Abascal, una jubilada de 87 años desahuciada en Madrid el 23 de septiembre tras resistir cuatro intentos de desalojo en una década, falleció el 7 de octubre en el hospital Gregorio Marañón. Su caso había desencadenado semanas antes una ola de protestas masivas contra la crisis de vivienda en España, que según varias fuentes contribuyó a la convocatoria de elecciones anticipadas. Tras conocerse su muerte, cientos de personas se manifestaron cerca del Parlamento español en Madrid para homenajearla y exigir medidas contra la especulación inmobiliaria.
sintesis.en: Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old pensioner evicted in Madrid on September 23 after resisting four eviction attempts over a decade, died on October 7 at Gregorio Marañón hospital. Her case had sparked weeks of mass protests against Spain's housing crisis, which reportedly contributed to the calling of a snap election. Following news of her death, hundreds gathered near the Spanish parliament in Madrid to honor her and demand action against real estate speculation.

titulo.es: Christa Pike, condenada a muerte en Tennessee, sobrevive a una ejecución fallida y despierta en el hospital
titulo.en: Death row inmate Christa Pike survives failed Tennessee execution and wakes up in hospital

sintesis.es: Christa Pike, condenada a muerte por el asesinato de una compañera de estudios en 1995, sobrevivió el 30 de septiembre a dos inyecciones letales de pentobarbital en Tennessee. Días después recuperó la consciencia y el habla, presenta neumonía y un coágulo sanguíneo, y según su defensa ya puede caminar por la habitación del hospital. Una jueza ordenó preservar las pruebas del procedimiento mientras los abogados exigen explicaciones; es el único caso documentado de supervivencia a una inyección letal en EE. UU., lo que ha generado un amplio debate mediático sobre el sistema de ejecuciones.
sintesis.en: Christa Pike, sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of a fellow student, survived two lethal pentobarbital injections in Tennessee on September 30. Days later she regained consciousness and speech, suffers from pneumonia and a blood clot, and according to her defense she can now walk around her hospital room. A judge ordered evidence from the procedure to be preserved while her lawyers demand explanations; this is the only documented case of survival after a lethal injection in the US, sparking wide media debate over the execution system.
